headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 中信证券：煤炭行业长期供需格局有望稳中向好，优质龙头的资源价值与盈利稳定性或将持续强化
headlines.summary: 中信证券研报认为，8月10日，国家发展改革委、国家能源局联合印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年大型现代化煤矿产能比重提升至87%、智能化煤矿产能比例提升至75%，五大煤炭供应保障基地产量占全国比重超过80%，并推动煤炭消费实现达峰。我们认为《规划》或将通过提升准入标准、优化产能结构、强化超产监管，推动煤炭供给端由增产保供进一步转向规范有序释放。在供给质量和行业集中度同步提升的大背景下，煤炭消费将实现稳步达峰，煤炭行业长期供需格局有望稳中向好，优质龙头的资源价值与盈利稳定性或将持续强化。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Long-Term Supply-Demand Pattern in Coal Industry Expected to Improve Steadily; Resource Value and Earnings Stability of High-Quality Leaders Likely to Keep Strengthening
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research report believes that on August 10, the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration jointly issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development," proposing to raise the proportion of large modern coal mine capacity to 87% by 2030, increase intelligent coal mine capacity to 75%, have the five major coal supply guarantee bases account for over 80% of national output, and promote coal consumption to peak. We believe the Plan may drive the coal supply side to shift from increasing production to ensure supply toward regulated and orderly release by raising access standards, optimizing capacity structure, and strengthening overproduction supervision. Against the backdrop of simultaneous improvement in supply quality and industry concentration, coal consumption will peak steadily, the long-term supply-demand pattern of the coal industry is expected to improve steadily, and the resource value and earnings stability of quality leaders may continue to strengthen.

headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Unveils "15th Five-Year" Reform and Development Plan, Accelerating Improvement of Central Bank System] A reporter learned on August 10 that the People's Bank of China recently issued the "PBOC '15th Five-Year' Reform and Development Plan," along with 9 supporting action plans for related sub-sectors. The Plan aims to accelerate the building of a strong financial nation, accelerate the improvement of the central bank system, and outline key tasks for the PBOC's reform and development during the "15th Five-Year" period.

headlines.title: 刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”
headlines.summary: 8月8日至10日，中共中央对外联络部部长刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”。其间，同古共中央第一书记、古巴国家主席迪亚斯-卡内尔，古共中央政治局委员、中央组织书记莫拉莱斯，古共中央国际关系部部长洛萨达等会见交流。双方表示，将共同落实好两党两国最高领导人达成的重要共识，赓续传统友谊，深化党际交往，加强战略沟通与协作，携手推进各自国家社会主义事业，为中古命运共同体建设作出更大贡献。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Liu Haixing Leads CPC Delegation to Visit Cuba and Attend First 'Fidel International Dialogue'
headlines.summary_en: From August 8 to 10, Liu Haixing, head of the International Department of the CPC Central Committee, led a CPC delegation to visit Cuba and attend the first "Fidel International Dialogue." During the visit, meetings were held with Cuba's First Secretary of the Communist Party Central Committee and President Miguel Díaz-Canel, Politburo member and Central Organization Secretary Roberto Morales, and International Relations Secretary Lozada, among others. Both sides expressed commitment to jointly implement the important consensus reached by the top leaders of the two parties and countries, carry forward traditional friendship, deepen inter-party exchanges, strengthen strategic communication and coordination, jointly advance the socialist cause of their respective countries, and make greater contributions to building a China-Cuba community with a shared future. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 综合多重因素，赴港投保性价比被重新评估
headlines.summary: 近日调研获悉，受“香港保单收益征税”消息影响，一些消费者正重新评估赴港投保性价比。已有多位香港保险营销员接到客户咨询，他们明显感受到市场正在降温。此外，随着人民币汇率不断升值，赴港投保的预期收益有所降低。在业内人士看来，受税收、汇率等因素影响，短期内消费者赴港投保将会降温，尤其是投资型保险产品受影响更大。对于消费者而言，未来赴港投保应综合考虑产品、汇率、合规、服务等多方面因素。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Considering Multiple Factors, Cost-Effectiveness of Hong Kong Insurance Purchases Being Reassessed
headlines.summary_en: A recent survey found that amid news of "taxation on Hong Kong policy income," some consumers are reassessing the cost-effectiveness of purchasing insurance in Hong Kong. Many Hong Kong insurance agents have received inquiries from clients, clearly sensing the market is cooling. Additionally, as the RMB exchange rate continues to appreciate, expected returns from policies purchased in Hong Kong have somewhat declined. Industry insiders believe that due to tax, exchange rate and other factors, consumer demand for Hong Kong insurance will cool in the short term, with investment-type products being more affected. For consumers, future purchases in Hong Kong should consider product, exchange rate, compliance, service and other factors comprehensively. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中国商务部: 自巴西进口的牛肉已达到保障措施规定数量的90%
headlines.summary: 中国商务部公告称，牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于2026年8月10日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家（地区）规定数量的90%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。

headlines.title_en: China's MOFCOM: Beef Imports from Brazil Have Reached 90% of the Volume Specified Under Safeguard Measures
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced that beef imported from Brazil under the beef safeguard measures has reached 90% of the specified quantity for that country (region) as stipulated in Ministry of Commerce Announcement No. 87 of 2025, as of August 10, 2026. According to Ministry of Commerce Announcement No. 87 of 2025, from the 3rd day (inclusive) after beef import volume reaches 100% of the specified quantity, a 55% tariff will be imposed on top of the current applicable tariff rate.

headlines.title: Hong Kong’s commercial property investment growth beats peer Asia-Pacific markets
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.
The 129 per cent growth from a year earlier beat other top-performing markets including Singapore with 108 per cent growth and Australia with an 82 per cent increase, data tracked by the property consultancy showed.

headlines.summary_zh: 据仲量联行称，香港商业地产投资在第二季度增长逾一倍，达到31亿美元，成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场，这得益于零售和写字楼成交的强劲增长以及低基数效应。129%的同比增幅超过了包括新加坡在内的其他表现优异的市场。

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title_zh: 在疲弱的香港零售物业市场中，麦当劳的资产有何突出之处？
headlines.summary_zh: 在麦当劳开始出售其自有香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近半数的物业组合找到了买家，尽管该市零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该物业组合的初始估值约为30亿港元（合3美元）。

headlines.title: 金融产品网络营销新规9月底起实施，保险业提前摸排整治账号端乱象
headlines.summary: 金融产品网络营销最严监管规定——《金融产品网络营销管理办法》将于9月30日起实施。记者从相关渠道获悉，针对办法对保险机构网络营销划定的“硬杠杠”，监管部门正在主动摸排整治账号端乱象、厘清市场生态，为新规落地铺路。受访人士表示，随着监管部门整治深入和办法落地实施，“机构担责+人证合一+可回溯”将是保险网络营销的最终走向。从长期看，这有利于降低消费者的信任成本，激活真实保险需求，推动保险机构业务质量、续保率等长期指标提升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New Rules on Online Marketing of Financial Products to Take Effect End of September; Insurance Industry Conducts Early Screening and Rectification of Account-Side Chaos
headlines.summary_en: The strictest regulatory rules for online marketing of financial products — the "Measures for the Administration of Online Marketing of Financial Products" — will take effect on September 30. A reporter learned from relevant channels that in response to the "hard requirements" the Measures set for insurance institutions' online marketing, regulators are proactively investigating and rectifying account-side irregularities and clarifying the market ecosystem to pave the way for the new rules. Interviewees said that with deeper regulatory crackdowns and implementation of the Measures, "institutional responsibility + identity verification + traceability" will be the ultimate direction for insurance online marketing. In the long run, this will help lower consumer trust costs, activate genuine insurance demand, and drive improvements in long-term indicators such as business quality and renewal rates for insurance institutions. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 高塔姆·阿达尼赢得美国证券欺诈指控的驳回
headlines.summary: 美国纽约东区联邦地区法院法官Nicholas Garaufis驳回了对高塔姆·阿达尼及其侄子萨加尔·阿达尼的共谋、证券欺诈和电信欺诈指控。 美国方面指控阿达尼参与了一项向印度政府官员行贿超过2.5亿美元以锁定太阳能合同的计划——阿达尼始终否认这些指控。 该裁决标志着阿达尼在美国法律麻烦的终结，此前他还曾与美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和财政部达成和解。

headlines.title_en: Gautam Adani Wins Dismissal of U.S. Securities Fraud Allegations
headlines.summary_en: Judge Nicholas Garaufis of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York dismissed charges of conspiracy, securities fraud, and wire fraud against Gautam Adani and his nephew Sagar Adani. U.S. authorities had accused Adani of involvement in a scheme to bribe Indian government officials over $250 million to secure solar contracts — Adani consistently denied the allegations. The ruling marks the end of Adani's U.S. legal troubles, following prior settlements with the SEC and the Treasury Department.

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: BSE liquidity trend may see a turning point driven by policy catalysts
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research report states that amid continued policy optimization at the Beijing Stock Exchange, capital operations are active, with simplified refinancing procedures directly addressing the "difficult and slow financing" pain points of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises. Moreover, Beijing Stock Exchange liquidity has bottomed out and rebounded. CITIC Securities believes the current BSE index liquidity is at a relatively low level, possibly at a valuation bottom and sentiment bottom.
